examples.text: When they caught him, he was branded and then locked up.

To mark (especially cattle) with a brand as proof of ownership.

examples.text: The ranch hands had to brand every new calf by lunchtime.

glosses: To make an indelible impression on the memory or senses.

examples.text: Her face is branded upon my memory.

glosses: To stigmatize, label (someone).

examples.text: He was branded a fool by everyone that heard his story.

glosses: To associate a product or service with a trademark or other name and related images.

examples.text: They branded the new detergent "Suds-O", with a nature scene inside a green O on the muted-colored recycled-cardboard box.

glosses: To be very hot, to burn.
